title: The agent opens its own code project and edits existing files as versioned patches
user_story: As the owner I want an agent such as Codex to create or open its code project and fix a line of its own code in place, versioned, instead of writing a new folder per run or needing a person to apply the fix (live run 2026-10-28; agent/PLAN_6.6.4_L3.md A3).

requirements.description: code.projects lists the code projects; code.create_project creates one (own folder, git repository) and opens it; code.open_project opens an existing one. Existing projects are never overwritten.

code.apply_patch edits an existing UTF-8 file of the open project in place, bound to its current sha256, with exact replacements that must each occur once, all-or-nothing, keeping the file's line endings.

Every patch is journalled outside the code folder (old/new sha256, edits, message, principal) and, in a git repository, committed on its own with only that file; code.file_version reports the sha256 and recent patches without content.
Paths outside the project, .git internals, missing, binary and over-1 MB files are refused; mutating tools need the workspace_write permission; no open project is a clear unavailable error.

nonfunctional: No new folder or file per edit
Under 1 s per patch including the git commit
The researcher's other uncommitted changes stay uncommitted
preconditions: A research project; a grant with workspace_write for mutations
postconditions: Every agent edit of existing code is recoverable from git or the patch journal
acceptance_criteria: Registry, code project, MCP, Hermes and ChatGPT suites pass

scenarios.expected: Create, list and open projects; unknown or unsafe names and duplicates are refused
The file changes in place, one commit with only that file, other work stays uncommitted, history listed
Stale sha256, ambiguous, absent or no-op edits change nothing; partial edits are not written
LF edits on a CRLF file keep CRLF
../, .git, missing and binary files are refused
Without git the patch is journalled outside the code folder
No open project answers unavailable with a hint
Mutating tools declare workspace_write; reads declare none
10 chained patches with commits in under 10 s

recovery: Fix at code_tools; never write outside the project, commit other files or skip the sha256 check. TASK-CODE-TOOLS-664, max three cycles.
test_environment: Disposable PHDLAB_DATA_DIR with real code projects, files and git (tests/_env.py); evidence in docs/qa/evidence/code-tools-664/.

tdd.scope: RED: 9 tests on ec928b9, all 9 failing (no code_tools module; the registry has no code.* tools). GREEN: 9/9.
